parameters.note: Antelope Lake (the reservoir behind Antelope Dam, also referred to by CDFW as Antelope Reservoir) is not separately listed in CCR §7.40(b) or §7.50(b), so the reservoir itself falls under the general statewide lake regulation in §5.85(a)(1). Note that §7.50(b)(5) lists 'Antelope Lake tributaries' with a special stream season (Sat. preceding Memorial Day through Sep. 30); that special regulation applies to the lake's tributary streams, not to the reservoir.

candidates.summary: Reservoir open all year (general statewide lake regulation; only its tributaries carry a special §7.50 stream season)

schedule.note: CDFW's 2026 Provisional Stocking Document for Trout and Inland Salmon lists Antelope Reservoir (Region 2, Plumas Co.) for sub-catchable-size Eagle Lake Trout under the Put and Grow program, with a stated release month range of April-November. This is CDFW's provisional plan for 2026, not a guaranteed annual constant.

CDFW's 2026 Provisional Stocking Document for Trout and Inland Salmon lists Antelope Reservoir (Region 2, Plumas Co.) for catchable-size Rainbow Trout under the Put and Take program, with a stated release month range of April-November. This is CDFW's provisional plan for 2026, not a guaranteed annual constant.
